help: capture browser-reachable chats via Safari into the room's stage, tmp/stage/input/ - corpus-yoga browser promote reaches data/input (a bare `corpus-yoga browser` audits capture-health)

args.name: --provider
args.help: every conversation of one provider, claude or gemini; with --id, one of them

args.name: --mechanism
args.help: restrict to one mechanism, API or DOM; every mechanism the provider has unless named

args.name: --id
args.help: capture ONE conversation, by its full id or a prefix of eight characters or more naming exactly one of the listing - filed under the full id, which a sweep overwrites in place (the audit FAILs name it); requires --provider - an id's shape does not say whose it is

args.name: --all
args.help: every conversation of every provider, every mechanism it has

args.name: --dry-run
args.help: discover and state the extent (captured / never-captured), then stop - captures nothing, writes nothing

does: for claude, fetches each conversation's JSON in the page, over the session's own authenticated API
for claude, GETs in the page each file asset the conversation JSON names (/api/<org>/files/<uuid>/<variant>) that the artifact library lacks - the capture completes the record (issues/422)
